description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Watch or pass on a contract or grant opportunity. Watching saves it to your list. Passing records why, so patterns emerge over time. Changes require applicable write access. Standard dynamically registered OAuth clients are read-only; approved OAuth write clients also require your explicit consent. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use.

action.description: watch, pass, unwatch, unpass, list, or remove_legacy
action.title: Action

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous watchlist page
cursor.title: Cursor

legacy_key.description: Opaque legacy_key returned for an unresolved old save; remove_legacy only
legacy_key.title: Legacy Key

note.description: Optional note with the pass reason
note.title: Note

notice_id.description: The contract notice ID or grant opportunity number (required for mutations)
notice_id.title: Notice Id

reason.description: Why passing (required for pass): wrong_fit, too_small, too_large, bad_timing, incumbent_locked, location, other
reason.title: Reason

record_type.description: Source record type. Required when IDs overlap; widget always supplies it.
record_type.title: Record Type
